title: Anonymous campus or workplace app
summary: Post anonymously to everyone at your school or company.
whyTempting: Anonymous apps spike in popularity and generate huge engagement fast.
whyItFails: Toxicity and bullying. Anonymity reliably produces harassment and defamation. Legal exposure. Hosts get dragged into complaints, subpoenas and takedown demands. Spike-and-crash. Engagement collapses once novelty and safety issues hit.
whatWouldChange: Probably nothing; the failure mode is structural, not technological.

attempts.notes: Anonymous posts to people nearby, popular on campuses; ceased in May 2017 and came back in 2021.
Anonymous posts to friends; the founder shut it down after it was used to spread malicious rumours.
